C0550.title: ChaPanda, Wallace, and Other Brands Hit by Empty Delivery Package Incidents
C0550.summary: In May 2024, netizens reported receiving empty packages in some food delivery orders involving brands such as ChaPanda, Wallace, Zhu Xiaoxiao Snail Noodles, and Niu Yue Bao. The businesses subsequently apologized and offered compensation; ChaPanda dismissed the involved employees and donated 1 million yuan, while Wallace provided 10x compensation for affected orders and disciplined the responsible
